prayerExcerpt.en-US: By showing compassion to all, may we gain forgiveness in your sight.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Praticando a misericórdia para com todos, alcancemos o vosso perdão.

meta.face: John: an old Pole of about seventy-five with a LONG, NARROW, sculpted face — a very high bald forehead and crown ringed by a short wreath of grey-white hair, prominent high cheekbones, a straight nose, heavy-lidded, half-closed gentle grey eyes, a ruddy complexion, full prominent lips, and a short, close grey beard following the line of the jaw; a kindly, downcast look toward the student. The student: a pale, thin Polish lad of about seventeen with a narrow face, straw-fair hair cut straight across the brow, and wide grateful blue eyes.
meta.basis: The inventory of sacred art of Małopolska describes his old portraits: an elderly balding man with a wreath of grey hair and a short grey beard, a high bald forehead, a ruddy face, a straight nose and full lips; another has an elongated face with half-closed eyes and prominent cheekbones, in a doctor's gown lined with red. The courtyard is the Collegium Maius, where he taught and lived, and the cloak is his best-known charity.
